scalar_verification: Every replayed main-stream, A/A, Karatsuba, Stage 0 and E34 walk reports correct = true, which the code sets only when the collision-recovered logarithm equals the instance's planted d and [d]G = Q holds on the curve (twist24_shortfall.rs, rho_j0_e41); all recover 271 on every curve, as E34's records do; the 32 F-slash control walks report correct = false with a wrong recovered value, byte for byte as committed. The validator's own checks: every n is prime and n = 1 mod 24 (own Miller-Rabin), and the recorded ideal equals sqrt(pi floor((n - 1)/m)/2) on every walk.

comparison.rule: each replayed record against the committed one: the replay driver's serialized record must equal the committed record's text byte for byte (the committed files are compact; this program re-serializes them verbatim), and every leaf is compared (key order, array lengths, number and string text). Stage 0 records were written by a different example (e41_stage0 at 6115e0ea0a) in another layout: every field they hold is compared against the replay's walk and instrument (native = cmp + hash + modn + neg + table). Whole files written by the rebuilt e41_run binary are compared byte for byte and leaf by leaf.
